{{Quote|Looks like the Sartinaynian system.''"<br />"''Yeah, it does.''"<br />"''Funny place to put an Imperial capital.|[[Lando Calrissian/Legends|Lando Calrissian]] and [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]]|<ref name="Vision of the Future">''[[Vision of the Future]]''</ref>}}
The '''Sartinaynian system''', also referred to as the '''Bastion system''' when it held the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Bastion/Legends|Capital]], was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located within the [[Braxant sector/Legends|Braxant sector]] in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]] region of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]]. [[Planet/Legends|Planets]] contained in this system were [[Bastion/Legends|Sartinaynian]] and a [[Sartinaynian system gas giant|gas giant]] with numerous [[Moon/Legends|moons]] and rings. The gas giant was inhabited by creatures similar to the [[Beldon/Legends|beldons]] of [[Bespin/Legends|Bespin]].
